lines.text: WERE you there when Judas pinpointed Him. 2ce
If you were there you will surely have pity, Were you there where Judas pinpointed Him.
Were you there when Peter denied Jesus. 2ce
Were you there at the time when the cock crowed. 2ce
Were you there when they found Jesus guilty.
Were you there when Jesus was crowned with thorns. 2ce
Were you there when they nailed Him to the cross. 2ce
Were you there when darkness descended down.
Were you there during Cherubim visit.
Were you there during Seraphim’s visit.
Were you there when they pricked Him with a sword.
Were you there when the temple’s cloth got rent.
Were you there when Jesus rose from the dead.
